River Rock Hand Towel Ring with Arched Mounts

text.description_html:
Fusion TR-A3, River Rock Hand Towel Ring with Arched Mounts

We love the Arched Wall Mounted Towel Ring not only because it is functional--keeping those damp hand towels out of the bathroom sink--but also because it is truly beautiful. Some traditional bathroom accessories are dated, but not this bronze scalloped towel ring. It has a simplistic beauty that makes it a lovely accompaniment to any powder room. Choose from medium bronze or dark bronze finishes.

Also Available Matching: Fusion TB-A3 Arched Towel Bar, Fusion RH-A3 Arched Robe Hook, and Fusion PH-A3 Arched Toilet Paper Holder

Features and Specifications of the Bronze Scalloped Hand Towel Ring:

  • Mount Width: 2-7/8"
  • Mount Length: 3-5/8"
  • Comes packaged with mounting hardware.

Sold Individually
